spans.s: bhuyo, adv. (m.c. for Skt. bhūyas), more, further: LV 〔54.9〕; bhuyu LV 〔240.19〕; 〔242.14〕; Dbh.g. 〔7(343).16〕; 〔8(344).7〕. All vss.
bhūyas-kāma-tā (= Pali bhiyyo-kamyatā; cf. prec.), desire for more, greed: Mvy 〔2208〕.

bhūyasya, ˚syā, ˚so, bhūyosya, with (in Mv rarely without) mātrayā (instr. of Skt. mātrā), or once mātrāṃ, = Pali bhiyyoso-mattāya, adv. or adverbial phrase, in specially high degree. The common BHS expression is bhūyasyā (instr. fem. of Skt. bhūyas-)mātrayā, e.g. SP 〔23.1〕; LV 〔321.17〕; Mv 〔ii.345.2〕 (vs, prob. read with v.l. ˚sya, m.c.); exceptionally bhūyasya (a m.c.?) mātrāṃ (so mss., Senart em. ˚aṃ) Mv 〔ii.338.13〕 (vs); twice, at least, in Mv the noun mātrayā is omitted (by error?), and text presents bhūyasya (so, a! but here prose) alone, 〔i.231.13〕. or, acc. to Senart with 5 of 6 mss., bhūyosya (cf. Pali) 〔i.3.14〕 (prose); in SP 〔71.10〕 (prose) ed. with Nep. mss. has the usual bhūyasyā mātrayā, but Kashgar rec. bhūyaso (intending Skt. ˚śo; cf. Pali bhiyyoso) mātrayā. See also s.v. yadbhūyasā.
bhūyo-'bhiprāya, m., desire for more, greed: Mvy 〔2213〕.

bhūyo-rucitā (so Index, and so Mironov except that he reads -rūcitā, with ū which seems surely erroneous; Kyōtō ed. text ˚rucitaḥ, which might^1 be a Bhvr. adj. from rucitā), = prec.: Mvy 〔2212〕.
